title: When approx will OneCoin be launched as Public Crypto Currency?
description: Ask Dr Ruja Ignatova Webinar (Part 14/18) Sign up Now: https://goo.gl/9OLq68.

asr.full_text: When is the expected date for launching one coin as a public cryptocurrency? As Laura as you say, the expected date. So there's no certainty. I cannot give exactly a date. What we are planning as a company is we are planning definitely in 2018 third to fourth quarter of the of the year. We are preparing. We currently have a big team preparing for this event. You can believe me, it is extremely hard work to go there. We want to do a very professional and a very good thing for all our users now but also for the future users so that they have trust in this coin and this coin after the GOING PUBLIC actually starts being even a bigger success than it has been until today. So expect the going public. Most probably in 2018.

The U.S. Department of Justice documented OneCoin as a fraudulent cryptocurrency-selling operation and sentenced a co-founder; the interview functions as promotional onboarding for that named scheme, not independent criticism of it.
